description.to:
Outcome: Every release that will reach the shared stack deploys to the staging shared stack first (PPY-1192d3), runs the adversarial suite (PPY-29f730), the golden renders and the call-count tests, and is blocked on any failure. The result is recorded on the release PR.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): CI workflows, docs/releasing.md.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/shared-release-gate.feature):
Scenario: A failing isolation case blocks the release
    Given the staging shared stack runs a release candidate
    When one adversarial case fails
    Then the release to the shared stack is blocked and the failing case is named

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-29f730, PPY-daf673. Blocks PPY-e51189. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-1192d3.

Testing: It is the test gate.
Rollout: CI.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: the gate slows releases. Mitigation: the suite runs in parallel and only on releases that reach the shared stack.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
